note: Media Responsive Thumbnail ships one field formatter, media_responsive_thumbnail ('Responsive thumbnail'), which extends core's ResponsiveImageFormatter and reuses its settings (responsive_image_style, image_link, image_loading). It registers for field_types=entity_reference but isApplicable() restricts it to entity-reference fields whose target_type is media, so it only ever appears on Media-reference fields. No settings form, no configure route (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, no plugin type of its own. All persistent state is the field's formatter settings in an entity_view_display config entity. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config on our own namespaced content type mrt_ct with a Media-reference field field_mrt_media and a namespaced responsive image style mrt_style (node.article is never touched).

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site I have a Media entity-reference field (points at Media entities, not a plain Image field) and I want it to render like an Image field using a Responsive Image style. Which contrib module and which field formatter do I use?
evals.expected_output: Use the Media Responsive Thumbnail module; set the field's Format to 'Responsive thumbnail' (formatter id media_responsive_thumbnail) on the entity's Manage display screen and choose a Responsive image style in its settings.

evals.prompt: The media_responsive_thumbnail formatter is declared for field_types entity_reference, yet it never shows up as a Format option on my entity-reference field to Taxonomy terms. Why not, and on what kind of entity-reference field does it appear?
evals.expected_output: Its isApplicable() method only returns TRUE when the entity-reference field storage's target_type setting is 'media', so the formatter is only offered on entity-reference fields that point at Media entities, never at taxonomy terms, users, or other entity types.

evals.prompt: A field on my site uses the media_responsive_thumbnail formatter to display Media entities, but one referenced media item is a Remote video whose oembed source field has no local image. What image does the formatter fall back to rendering for that item?
evals.expected_output: It falls back to the media entity's own 'thumbnail' field: the formatter uses the media type's source field first, and only when that field is empty does it render the media entity's thumbnail image instead.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, content type mrt_ct has a Media reference field field_mrt_media whose default view display uses the media_responsive_thumbnail formatter. Inspect the live default view display and state which responsive image style its formatter is configured to use.
evals.expected_output: mrt_style: in core.entity_view_display.node.mrt_ct.default the field_mrt_media component (type media_responsive_thumbnail) has settings.responsive_image_style set to mrt_style.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, content type mrt_ct's field_mrt_media is displayed with the media_responsive_thumbnail formatter. Inspect the live default view display configuration and state what the rendered image links to (its image_link setting).
evals.expected_output: It links to the media item's own canonical page: in core.entity_view_display.node.mrt_ct.default the field_mrt_media component's settings.image_link is 'media' (not 'content', which would link to the node, and not empty/no link).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, content type mrt_ct has a Media reference field field_mrt_media currently displayed with a plain entity-reference formatter. A responsive image style mrt_style already exists. Switch field_mrt_media's default view display to use the Media Responsive Thumbnail module's 'Responsive thumbnail' formatter, configured to use the mrt_style responsive image style. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.mrt_ct.default the field_mrt_media component's type is media_responsive_thumbnail and its settings.responsive_image_style is mrt_style (e.g. set the component and save, or pick 'Responsive thumbnail' + 'mrt_style' on Manage display).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, content type mrt_ct's field_mrt_media is already displayed with the media_responsive_thumbnail formatter (responsive image style mrt_style), but the rendered image is not linked to anything. Update its formatter settings so the rendered image links to the referenced media item itself (not the node), and apply the change to the live default view display.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.mrt_ct.default the field_mrt_media component (still type media_responsive_thumbnail) has settings.image_link set to 'media', which makes getMediaThumbnailUrl() link to the media item's own canonical page.
